hook: Your Angel Falls photo shows water turning into mist.
title: The tallest waterfall turns to mist midair
description: Angel Falls in Venezuela is the world's tallest waterfall, with a drop of 979 metres. That is taller than the Burj Khalifa. Much of the water turns to mist before it reaches the ground.
comment_prompt: Would you visit? Yes or no
